trigger: The harness gate is complete or the next action belongs to a separate product/runtime integration owner.
steps: Generate lua-harness-report.md and lua-readiness.json from the tracked status reporter.
Record the exact proof ceiling and all unresolved promotion gates.
When product embedding is next, require an explicit runtime sprint that pins Lua version/API and owns host wrapper code.
Name the first executable downstream validator or runtime action; do not substitute generic review/test advice.
Keep generated evidence outside tracked authority.
failureHandling: If current evidence is stale or contradictory, regenerate status before handoff.
proofCeiling: handoff state only; no runtime promotion
